summary.content:
Today's selection covers 109 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 71 on Artificial Intelligence and 15 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Microsoft C.E.O. Satya Nadella Says ‘Everyone Is a Stakeholder’ in A.I.
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Nottingham University data breach affects over 450,000 students
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, BleepingComputer, Krebs on Security, Dark Reading, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 58 articles published in the last 24 hours
